About Us

Last updated: January 2025

Who We Are

RO Service Support is a professional water purifier service center based in Bangalore, Karnataka. We specialize in doorstep RO repair, installation, maintenance, and annual maintenance contracts (AMC) for all types of water purifiers. Our mission is to ensure every household and business in Bangalore has access to clean, safe, and healthy drinking water.

What We Do

We provide end-to-end water purifier services including repair, new installation, filter and membrane replacement, deep cleaning, and commercial RO maintenance. Our team of certified and background-verified technicians is available 24x7 to respond to your service requests at your convenience.

Our Commitment

We believe in honest pricing, genuine spare parts, and reliable service. Every repair we perform comes with a 30-day service warranty. We use only original filters, membranes, and cartridges from trusted manufacturers to make sure your purifier keeps working at its best.

Why Customers Trust Us

  • 24x7 customer service support in Bangalore
  • Certified and verified technicians
  • Fast 60-minute doorstep response
  • Transparent pricing starting at ₹299
  • 100% genuine spare parts
  • 30-day service warranty on every repair
